buildCommand: curl -sSL -O https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh && chmod +x dotnet-install.sh && ./dotnet-install.sh --version 10.0.301 --install-dir ./.dotnet && export DOTNET_ROOT=$(pwd)/.dotnet && export PATH=$PATH:$(pwd)/.dotnet && export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 && dotnet publish src/HKLifeSim.Web/HKLifeSim.Web.csproj -c Release -o publish
